title: Movement counts bounded by time
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, let $y$ be a finite Boolean word, and let $t$ be a natural number. Every coordinate of the movement-count vector at time $t$ is at most $t$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over Boolean symbols
the coordinate is arbitrary in the count vector
replaced: For every source machine, virtual input $y$, time $t$, and coordinate, the stored movement count at time $t$ is at most $t$.
